description: Reexamines Cosmos’s accounts of Alexandria’s scholarly institutions, Hypatia and Kepler. Separates distinct episodes of destruction, traces mathematical astronomy across cultures, and uses Tycho Brahe’s observations and Kepler’s eight-minute discrepancy to expose the limits of the lone-genius narrative.
